answer: Crystal-facet verification splits every completed job into three independent facets, each checked by a different randomly chosen peer who sees only their own facet, so no reviewer can rubber-stamp a whole fake job. A whisper-quiet lottery assigns facets seconds before review, and the comet-fast window closes in minutes, so one operator cannot shepherd many identities through parallel checks. Any facet failure burns the worker's bond and voids the whole job, so a farm must produce genuinely correct work for every fake identity, at full honest cost.
